MySettings.title: My settings
MySettings.body: Here you choose how TILL looks to you: the colour scheme, the density, and whatever further areas offer later. Your choices apply to you alone and follow you into every browser, because TILL keeps them with your books rather than in the browser. A change applies at once. Reset returns one setting or a whole group to its default. How the workspace behaves for everyone is set in the settings under Setup.
